meta.name: Eken Babu
meta.description: Eken Babu is not your average, middle-aged Bengali man. He is Ekendra Sen, a detective extraordinaire who effortlessly cracks complex cases in his own quirky style. And wherever a mystery takes him, he is accompanied by his friends, Bapi and Pramatha.

videos.title: Two deaths, one mystery
videos.overview: Eken Babu reaches an apartment in Bangalore, much to the mixed reaction of its residents, who later find one of their fellow residents dead.

videos.title: Suicide or Murder?
videos.overview: Police start their investigation to find the reason behind Kirit Patel’s untimely death. Meanwhile, Eken Babu seems no less keen to know the cause as well.

videos.title: Doubt... Doubt...
videos.overview: Eken Babu’s curiosity about Kirit Patel’s death leaves everyone irritated. However, Eken Babu is eager to meet astrologer Shailen Sapui to ask about his future.

videos.title: An Astrologer\'s Day
videos.overview: Bapi and Pramatha take Eken Babu to Shailen Sapui’s chamber. But will he be able to live up to Eken Babu’s expectations of being a ‘genius’?

videos.title: The Diary
videos.overview: Eken’s curiosity takes him to the deceased - Kirit Patel’s apartment, where he finds a diary. Will it be a lead to the cause of his untimely death?

videos.title: Murder He Says
videos.overview: A restless Eken Babu leaves no-stone-unturned to investigate Kirit Patel’s death. But what is his own motive behind the eagerness?

videos.title: The Missing Friday
videos.overview: Despite Bapi and Pramatha suspecting him, Eken reads Patel’s diary and finds, that all his Friday chronicles are missing. Do these pages have the answer to his death?

videos.title: Pink Elephant
videos.overview: With every step forward, Eken Babu is nearing the conclusion to Patel’s death. Little is he aware, that someone else is spying on his actions too.

videos.title: Hard Rock
videos.overview: His ceaseless investigations lead him to a certain twist in the tale. It is at this point of time, that Eken Babu decides it’s time for a showdown.

videos.title: Final Showdown
videos.overview: It's a curtain call for all, as everyone awaits for the truth behind Kirit Patel's murder to unfold.

videos.title: Bentumashir Goendagiri
videos.overview: It’s Durga Pujo and Eken Babu is super excited to celebrate it in Banglaore with Bapi and Pramatha. Will it become one memorable Pujo for him?

videos.title: Natural death, ami penguin
videos.overview: A murder in Bangalore creates tension amongst everyone, while it increases curiosity in Eken Babu, needless to say. Is he ready to don the detective’s hat?

videos.title: Dui Mrityu Ekdine
videos.overview: Eken Babu comes across certain evidences that turns around the case to an unthinkable situation. Will it turn even worse for him?

videos.title: This Man Is Something
videos.overview: Eken Babu is supposed to continue with the investigation. On the contrary, he brings some uncalled surprises for Bapi, Pramatha, and ACP Rupal Mehra!

videos.title: Sunglass Pore Rajnikanth
videos.overview: Before the mystery can be sorted out by Eken, another murder alarms everyone. On the other hand, someone is closely following every step that he is taking.

videos.title: Bhol Bodoler Rongo
videos.overview: As unlikely as his resemblance with an investigator, Eken Babu unmasks the most unsuspected of the lot as the main culprit, once again!

videos.title: Destination Dhaka
videos.overview: Eken Babu is in Dhaka to attend a literary meet. Will he smell something fishy when a man dies of a heart attack at a party?

videos.title: Mrityu Mystery
videos.overview: Bapi and Pramatha discourage Eken Babu to stop investigating Masud's sudden death. Will he listen to his friends - or will he continue his quest for truth?

videos.title: Ekengiri
videos.overview: No one believes that Masud's death is an unnatural one. But how do Bapi and Pramatha gradually join Eken Babu's investigations?

videos.title: Highly Suspicious
videos.overview: Eken Babu gets attacked by goons at a cafe in Dhaka. Will he be able to fight them off and find a cause for the unnatural death?

videos.title: Kolkata Chalo
videos.overview: Even as Eken Babu gets closer to solving the mystery, he still struggles to put an end. find the truth before he leaves Dhaka?

videos.title: Shiraz-er Biriyani
videos.overview: Eken reaches Burman House in search of some royal history and food. But there's an attempt of murder on Tunganath, the owner of the house.

videos.title: Agontuk
videos.overview: The advent of Satyakam, a historian researcher in this Burman family, creates new tension. Who is Satyakam?

videos.title: Chitro Bichitro
videos.overview: Eken uncovers a dark secret about Tunganath's past. Satyakam commits suicide. Is there a connection?

videos.title: Jolponar Kolpona
videos.overview: Eken's suspicion tells him that Satyakam's suicide is a murder. But how will he prove it?

videos.title: Porda Phash
videos.overview: There's a cloud of unease around Tunganath's will. Will Eken get to the bottom of it?

videos.title: Shunani
videos.overview: Eken catches the real culprit and reveals how things are connected by retelling the history of Burman house.

videos.title: Thik Dukkurbela
videos.overview: Eken and Bapi travel to Bolpur for a quick getaway. Shortly after, a murder occurs.

videos.title: Kothay Pabo Tare?
videos.overview: Eken, Bapi and Rupal Mehra see that the red diamond is missing. Meanwhile, Suresh Mitra can't be found anywhere.

videos.title: Outhouse-ey Henyali
videos.overview: Following another death and the discovery of a cryptic clue, the police catch a suspect. But the case is far from closed.

videos.title: Ulot Puran
videos.overview: Eken gets some vital information from a surprising source. Inspecting the earlier clue again reflects light on two more suspects.

videos.title: Female Moumachhi
videos.overview: Eken seems to have cracked the case. A leisurely night walk of Eken and Bapi turns into a thrilling chase.

videos.title: National Anthem
videos.overview: Eken reveals to Bapi and Rupal the series of events that led to the two deaths.

videos.title: Kolkatay Kelenkari
videos.overview: The much-awaited homecoming for the trio takes a turn when Eken is appointed to investigate a mysterious death in the City of Joy.

videos.title: Picnic
videos.overview: Eken, Bapi and Pramatha start interrogating the usual suspects while the city witnesses another murder, thereby setting off a bizarre number game.

videos.title: Doping
videos.overview: Eken becomes desperate to find any connection between Bikash and Tanmoy that can help in cracking the number game. Meanwhile, the killer makes his next move.

videos.title: Badminton
videos.overview: While the case gets more complex with mystifying discoveries about Bikash Sen, the killer suddenly changes the pattern of his number game.

videos.title: Destination Ranchi
videos.overview: The revelation of Bikash's gruesome past leads Eken to untangle a crucial end of the case. Rupal comes back to reveal the main culprit.

videos.title: Tribhuj na Choturbhuj
videos.overview: Eken makes a shocking discovery about an old unsolved case that unveils the perpetrators.

videos.title: Tungkulung
videos.overview: While exploring the Tungkulung forest with Bapi and Promotho, Eken Babu  stumbles upon the dead body of the local king, Shyamsunder Rana.

videos.title: Rail Roko
videos.overview: Eken meets Binoy Prodhan, the estate heir. Things turn suspicious when the late king's lawyer points out the recent changes in his will.

videos.title: Bish
videos.overview: Everyone from the royal family joins Eken's list of suspects, followed by their inconsistent statements. Back in the police station, Eken finds out the motive behind the murder.

videos.title: Ondher Joshthi
videos.overview: When Binoy discloses the menacing behaviour of Shyamsundar Rana's business partner, Shaibal Babu, it throws light on a new angle of the mystery.

videos.title: Hirer Sandhaney
videos.overview: Although police trace Binoy's phone location near the death spot, Eken discovers a deadly conspiracy rooted in decades-old secrets and a precious diamond's history.

videos.title: Otit-er Khonjey
videos.overview: When Eken Babu becomes determined to know more of Binoy's past, a startling revelation comes to the fore.

videos.title: Bhanumotir Khel
videos.overview: Eken Babu arrives at the royal palace to unmask the killer. But will he divulge the invaluable thing that the killer was craving?

videos.title: Raghurajpure Rawktopaat
videos.overview: Eken is tricked into solving the mystery behind the death threats received by a Kathakali artist.

videos.title: Khondogirir Laash
videos.overview: After the mysterious death of Paramita's friend, the police call on Eken as the suspect list keeps growing.

videos.title: Guest House-ey Khun
videos.overview: Eken seeks clues from Paramita and Anuradha's dance teacher, but a sudden death complicates the case further.

videos.title: Samudra Phiriye Dey
videos.overview: As Eken closes in on the murderer, another death throws the case into deeper chaos.

videos.title: Plot Bordhon
videos.overview: A vicious attack lands Eken in the hospital, where he uncovers long-buried secrets from Paramita's past.

videos.title: Shakkhigopal
videos.overview: Eken has to uncover the final piece of the puzzle before confronting everyone.

videos.title: Khuner Panda
videos.overview: Eken unveils a long-buried truth that leaves everyone shaken.
